page.overview:
Who is Tamzin Flaxenraad?

Tamzin Flaxenraad was an Imperial Treasurer.

Tamzin Flaxenraad was born on Alpha Hydrae, the fifth son of Graf Heino Flaxenraad. Due to how far he was in the line of succession, he was devalued and could hope for no better honor than a position in finance or the House Guard. He became the Imperial Treasurer in Arrakeen, where it was his duty to recieve, count and convey the right and proper incomes of the Padishah Emperor Shaddam Corrino IV.

Tamzin Flaxenraad was approached by the Prisoner at the Imperial Consulate in Arrakeen. He explained to them his background and his responsibilities, all while complaining about being in a position he saw as beneath him.
